Scenario fixture: svg-image-text-alternative-present (“SVG <image> must have a text alternative”)

Each test SVG image has a stable id of the form svgimg_case_XX. These cases focus on SVG <image> elements and text alternative mechanisms.

A. Baseline (eligible)

01 — FAIL: SVG <image> missing title/desc and ARIA name
No <title>, no <desc>, no ARIA name.
02 — PASS: SVG <image> with direct <title>
Title provides alternative.
03 — PASS: SVG <image> with aria-label
ARIA name provides alternative.

B. aria-hidden eligibility behavior

04 — NOT APPLICABLE: aria-hidden and not tabbable
Ineligible (aria-hidden, not tabbable, not IDREF-referenced).
05 — FAIL: aria-hidden but tabbable (tabindex=0), unnamed
Eligibility override: tabbable focus makes it applicable.

C. Role exclusions (presentation/none)

06 — NOT APPLICABLE: role=presentation and not focusable
Excluded by role when not focusable.
07 — FAIL: role=presentation but focusable (tabindex=0), unnamed
Focusable overrides role exclusion; still requires a text alternative.

D. Inertness

08 — NOT APPLICABLE: inert ancestor makes image ineligible
Ineligible due to inert ancestor.

E. IDREF reference exception

09 — FAIL: aria-hidden but IDREF-referenced, unnamed
This element references the image by IDREF.
Eligibility override: referenced by IDREF, so it remains applicable.

F. <title>/<desc> DOM-position rules

10 — FAIL: <title> that is NOT the first child element
A <title> that isn't the first child element is not read as the alternative.
11 — PASS: <desc> as the first child element
<desc> as the first child provides the alternative.
12 — PASS: empty <title> first child, <desc> immediately second
Standard <title>+<desc> pairing: desc as second child immediately after title counts.
13 — FAIL: <desc> that is neither first child nor pair-second after <title>
A misplaced <desc> is not read as the alternative.

G. Accessible-name attribute mechanisms

14 — PASS: HTML title attribute (best-effort accessible name)
Title attribute is accepted as an accessible-name mechanism.
15 — PASS: aria-labelledby referencing non-empty text
Logo label ARIA idref name counts.

H. Guardrails: conditions that should NOT exclude eligibility

16 — FAIL: opacity:0 should remain eligible
Opacity does not exclude eligibility; missing alternative => fail.
17 — FAIL: offscreen should remain eligible
Offscreen does not exclude eligibility; missing alternative => fail.

I. Hidden by HTML/CSS and non-composed content (ineligible)

18 — NOT APPLICABLE: ancestor <svg> display:none
display:none makes it ineligible.
19 — NOT APPLICABLE: ancestor <svg> visibility:hidden
visibility:hidden makes it ineligible.
20 — NOT APPLICABLE: inside <template> (non-composed)
Template content is not composed into the DOM.

End of fixture.
